title: •Jawa Pack
caption: •Jawa Pack (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your unique (•) Jawas are defense value +1. During battles at exterior Tatooine sites where your unique (•) Jawa is participating, may add one destiny to your total power.
lore: Jawas travel in packs for protection. They use ambush tactics against unwary droids in the canyons of the Jundland Wastes. “Aeeeyaa!”
